_notes: Fuel load estimates in tons/acre keyed by LANDFIRE EVC (Existing Vegetation Cover) integer code. EVC encodes vegetation lifeform and canopy cover class. Classes 101-149 are tree cover (low to high density), 151-199 are shrub cover, 201-249 are herbaceous cover. Values above 100 indicate vegetated land; values 11-20 are sparse/non-vegetated classes; 0 and 32767 are nodata/background. Fuel loads are a simplified approximation based on LANDFIRE EVC class descriptions and published wildland fire fuel loading references (Scott & Burgan 2005, Ottmar et al. 2007). Calibrate against field data for production use.
